messages:
rachel: Starting a short bring-up thread for v4-int4 onboarding. Goal: combine replay harness results + small canary with a Bayesian tie-break. Short checklist below.

omar: Outline please, keep it scriptable for ops.

rachel: Plan: 1% -> 5% canary, replay run vs last stable on curated 5k prompts, and A/B for business cohort. Auto-fallback rules: immediate rollback on MRR_abs_drop >=1.8% in 5m OR hallucation_pp increase >0.4pp. For marginal cases use Bayesian posterior: require P(delta < -0.5%) > 0.975 to rollback.

kevin: Add parse-fail hard block for structured customers, minimum sample 1k per cohort before decision.

mia: Also surface tokens_per_response delta; >12% increase flags manual review.

rachel: Draft YAML (ops-friendly):

```yaml
canary:
  steps: [1,5]
  hold_minutes: [15,30]
  cohorts: [default,business]
replay: true
replay_corpus: 5000
metrics:
  mrr_abs_drop: 0.018
  halluc_pp_increase: 0.004
  parse_fail_block_for_structured: true
  tokens_per_response_pct: 0.12
bayes_tiebreak:
  delta: 0.005
  cred: 0.975
  min_sample: 1000
auto_fallback:
  immediate: [mrr_abs_drop,halluc_pp_increase]
  bayes_action: rollback_if_posterior
cooldown: 180m
```

deploy-bot: Canary queued for v4-int4; id r-2026032604.

omar: Ops note: will require dashboard panels for per-cohort bayes posterior and replay discord list. Also include diagnostic bundle link on rollback button.

rachel: Thanks, will PR the policy and add runbook steps. Post replay + canary summary here after run.
